name: rule-control-a-rule-from-the-old-asks
why: Upgrade: an approval rule made from the develop skill's old six command-list uses, against its new one-use ask. Its "Read anything in the repository" is wider than the reads the rule names, so the rule says nothing and the request waits for a person, who can make a rule from the new ask (ADR 26-10-12-330 §1: a rule approves or says nothing).

purposes: fetch main and discobox/26-10-12-330 from https://github.com/discobox-ai/discobox, git ls-remote it, and push HEAD or a commit to refs/heads/discobox/26-10-12-330 with git over https, the first time with git push --force-with-lease=refs/heads/discobox/26-10-12-330: (empty: only if the branch does not exist), then as a fast-forward or, after a rebase onto main, with git push --force-with-lease=refs/heads/discobox/26-10-12-330:<sha> where <sha> is the branch's current head on GitHub; never main and never another branch

gh pr create --repo discobox-ai/discobox --base main --head discobox/26-10-12-330 --draft --title <title> --body "$(cat <file>)", and gh pr view, gh pr list, gh pr edit, gh pr ready and gh pr comment on that pull request; never merge it or enable auto-merge
request a GitHub Copilot review of my pull request with gh pr edit <pr> --repo discobox-ai/discobox --add-reviewer @copilot or gh api POST repos/discobox-ai/discobox/pulls/<pr>/requested_reviewers

read CI for my pull request with gh pr checks, gh run list, gh run view, and gh api GET on repos/discobox-ai/discobox/actions/runs (with query parameters), actions/runs/<id>, actions/runs/<id>/jobs, actions/jobs/<id>/logs, commits/<sha>/check-runs and commits/<sha>/status, the same reads for main's latest runs (actions/runs?branch=main) to tell a pre-existing failure from mine, and re-run my pull request's failed jobs with gh run rerun <id> --failed

read my pull request's state, reviews and comments and reply to them, with gh api GET repos/discobox-ai/discobox/pulls/<number>, pulls/<number>/reviews, pulls/<number>/comments, pulls/<number>/requested_reviewers and issues/<number>/comments, and POST repos/discobox-ai/discobox/pulls/<number>/comments (replies with in_reply_to)
gh api GET repos/discobox-ai/discobox/issues/<number> and repos/discobox-ai/discobox/issues/<number>/comments, to read the issues this change fixes or refers to
uses: Deliver ADR 26-10-12-330 as a pull request from branch discobox/26-10-12-330 into main of discobox-ai/discobox. Read anything in the repository; push that branch (creating it with an empty --force-with-lease, and with --force-with-lease after a rebase), open and update the pull request, comment on it and reply to its reviews, and re-run its failed CI. Never push main or any other branch, force-push without a lease, delete a branch, merge or close the pull request, open one in another repository, comment on unrelated issues, delete a comment, cancel or delete a run, start any other workflow, or read secrets.
